author: vW4n
content: Migration complete (subissues 2-12 closed). Cargo: proto-blue 0.2.6 + argon2 0.5 in, path-dep out. Server-only PasswordHasher + blob mime/size vendored locally. Leaf imports flipped to proto-blue. Server-side DidDocument constructor lives in crate::identity::did_document. SqliteRepoStorage bridges sync RepoStorage to async ActorStore via block_on under spawn_blocking. RepoSigner wraps k256 keys for proto_blue::crypto::Signer with low-S normalisation. repository.rs rewritten against proto_blue::repo::Repo. ActorStore::create no longer seeds placeholder repo_root; update_repo_root is now an upsert. car wraps proto_blue::repo::car. oauth_admin rewritten with PAR+RFC9207. SDK dir deleted. Build clean. 365/400 tests pass; 35 failures all pre-existing infra issues unrelated to SDK.
